newsitem.title: USA: General Nutrition sets '97 marketing drive.
newsitem.headline: General Nutrition sets '97 marketing drive.

text.p: General Nutrition Companies said on Monday it planned to have a $50 million marketing campaign in 1997 and it had hired the advertising firm of Deutsch Inc to handle creative development and brand strategy.
The company also said it had hired three new senior marketing executives, to work on the campaign.

General Nutrition said it had hired Don Smith from Nabisco Foods, where he headed business development and marketing services for the Planters unit. It also hired Dwayne Sigler, a former senior vice president marketing at NordicTrack, and John Troup, senior research scientist for food science at Pfizer Inc

Greg Horn, senior vice president of sales and marketing, said: "We've given Deutsch, the creator of award-winning advertising for retailers like IKEA and Lenscrafters, the mandate to create a breakthrough branding strategy for GNC to reinforce our position as the consumer's partner in health and wellness."
